name: Buena Vista del Rincón

transfer_minutes.label: Approximately 45 minutes to one hour from Liberia's Daniel Oduber Quirós International Airport (LIR), about 31 km away.

hero_image_alt: Buena Vista del Rincón, a Eco Adventure Mountain Lodge in Rincón de la Vieja, Costa Rica
description: Buena Vista del Rincón is an eco adventure park, hotel and spa nestled in the rainforest foothills of the Rincón de la Vieja volcano in Guanacaste. With 76 rooms, natural volcanic hot springs, and an on-site adventure park, it blends thrill and relaxation in a lush mountain setting.
hero_description: A rainforest eco-lodge and adventure park on the slopes of the Rincón de la Vieja volcano.
local_insight: Ideal for active travelers and families who want ziplining, waterfalls and volcanic hot springs all in one place. The unpaved access road can be tricky for small rental cars, so consider a private transfer.

luxury.reason: identity.luxury_level is Upscale, but description provides no refined-service or luxury-specific markers.

families.reason: Nature-Loving Families profile cites family-friendly activities for all ages and free hot springs.

couples.reason: No couples/honeymoon profile; entirely adventure and family-framed.

wellness.reason: Volcanic hot springs, natural sauna and mud baths, with a dedicated Wellness Travelers profile.

adventure_access.reason: On-site adventure park with zip line, 420-meter water slide, hanging bridges and horseback riding; Adventure Seekers profile calls it a full day of adrenaline.

faq.q: Does the hotel have natural volcanic hot springs?
faq.a: Yes, the hotel features crystal-clear volcanic hot springs, a natural sauna, mineral-rich volcanic mud baths and cold pools set within a private wildlife refuge.

faq.q: Do I need to stay overnight to enjoy the hot springs and activities?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Day Passes are available for visitors who want to enjoy the hot springs, volcanic spa and Eco Adventure Park without staying overnight.

faq.q: Do you offer airport transportation from Liberia?
faq.a: Yes, both private and shared transfers from Liberia International Airport (LIR) can be arranged in advance via WhatsApp or the reservations team.

amenities: Natural sauna and volcanic mud baths
